About Quick Pool Services

Quick Pool Services specialises in swimming pool construction, installation, maintenance, cleaning, repairs and renovation.

The company provides practical solutions for pool owners who need new pool construction, pool maintenance, equipment repairs, water circulation improvements, resurfacing, renovation and related swimming pool services.

Pool Construction

Quick Pool Services provides swimming pool construction and installation services, including fibreglass pools, above-ground pools and custom pool designs.

Pool Maintenance and Cleaning

Pool maintenance services include routine pool cleaning, equipment checks, water circulation checks and general maintenance to help keep swimming pools clean, functional and safe.

Pool Equipment Repairs

Quick Pool Services provides swimming pool equipment services including pump repairs, pump replacement, filter sand replacement and troubleshooting of pool circulation problems.

Pool Renovation

Pool renovation services can include resurfacing, marbelite work, tiling, lighting improvements, equipment upgrades and other pool improvement work.

Additional Services

Quick Pool Services also provides Jacuzzi installation and repairs, water features and Koi pond services.
